title: Works With Issues
text:
Works With Issues. I'm a bit disappointed with this. No where in the description does it say or show that this sits on a base to heat. I was hoping that it just plugged in. I already have one on a base and the whole thing is hard to store and keep together. I like that this is digital and that it can be adjusted for various varieties of tea. It is easy to use.
Difficult to clean because the lid is attached and the average hand isn't going to fit inside of it. There is also reference to a filter that needs to be cleaned. The only filter I see is the large holed grate across the spout on the inside. The manual makes it sound like the filter is something removable. All in all it's rather expensive and it is also very large.

description: With the Krups Glass Kettle, the convenience of electric kettles meets the elegance of glass. Made from pure, natural glass material, it fully preserves the authentic taste of water for perfectly flavored teas. Its beauty and transparency will captivate, as will the magic of the lighting effects created by boiling water in motion. This kettle is made of a high glass resistance for better durability over thermal shocks, and this material is 100% recyclable!
